title: Probing Rotational Dynamics of Quark Gluon Plasma via Global Vorticity
summary: The findings on the spin polarization of $Λ$, $Ξ$, and $Ω$ hyperons and spin alignment of $K^{*0}$, $φ$, and $D^{*+}$ mesons in relativistic heavy-ion collision experiments at the RHIC and LHC facilities propose the emergence of a strong vorticity field produced in these collisions. Contemplating the potential impact of vorticity on the space-time evolution of deconfined QCD matter and its freeze-out properties, we aim to investigate its characteristics within the medium.
